Maya Patel: Heads-up — we need the Acme QBR deck locked by EOD Thursday. High level asks: exec summary, renewal risk, onboarding status, and enablement gaps. 
Liam Chen: I can own the performance slide. Will pull token usage, tail latency, and platform cost delta. Need redwood-prod query access from eng-sre.
Sarah Gomez: I'll draft the exec summary + renewal risk framing. Quick question — is the renewal date still Sep 28?
Dinesh Reddy: Onboarding status + enablement items on me. I'll surface the remaining checklist and who still needs training. Can someone paste the latest success plan link?
Maya Patel: Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/ACME-ONBOARDING-PLAN — please add notes inline.
Liam Chen: Added a metrics table, flagged the 3 regressions we saw in June.
Sarah Gomez: Renewal date confirmed — Sep 28. Renewal MRR is $42,000. I propose a risk tier: Medium until we close the remaining two integrations.
Maya Patel: Agree. For exec alignment, want a 2-slide ask: (1) impact/usage + trend, (2) top risks + mitigation ask. Dinesh, can you summarize enablement ask into a single bullet with required dates?
Dinesh Reddy: Sure — enablement ask: complete API integration training for 4 PMs and 2 Engs by Aug 18; propose 90-min remediation workshop w/ field engineers week of Aug 21.
qbr_bot: Reminder: QBR rehearsal scheduled Thu 11:00 AM in Conference Room B. (Auto-reminder sent 3543210180)
Maya Patel: Can we run a 15-min dry run Mon 9:30a? Need exec slide order + 3 talking points per owner.
Liam Chen: 9:30a works. I'll prep two talking points: 1) sustained 95th pct latency, 2) recent cost-optimization wins.
Sarah Gomez: I'll bring renewal narrative + 1 escalation ask: extend pilot discount for final integration window.
Dinesh Reddy: I'll bring onboarding heatmap and proposed workshop agenda.
Maya Patel: Action items: 1) Liam — finalize metrics slide by Mon 8am. 2) Sarah — final renewal framing + ask by Mon 8am. 3) Dinesh — onboarding heatmap + workshop invite by Mon 12pm. 4) All — review deck and add comments by Tue EOD.
Liam Chen: Action noted.
Sarah Gomez: Added my slide; @Maya please confirm tone.
Maya Patel: Tone's good — keep it outcome-focused, not tactical. Add one customer quote if possible.
Dinesh Reddy: Pushed the workshop invite to calendar and tagged the two engineers.
Maya Patel: Thanks — looping in @Liam and @Dinesh for a final pass before rehearsal. :thumbsup:
qbr_bot: Thread archived to project ACME-QBR after 3 replies.
